WITH invoice_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    SUM(derived_product_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) as invoice_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  WHERE derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL 
    AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
average_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM invoice_metrics
  WHERE invoice_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  im.invoice_number,
  im.invoice_ratio,
  im.line_item_count,
  im.invoice_ratio / ar.avg_ratio as relative_ratio
FROM invoice_metrics im
CROSS JOIN average_ratio ar
WHERE ar.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
